scope: review11 rework: Bluetooth platform trust and AMFI LWCR, Samsung DWC3 Host state, single-MSI ath11k IRQ correctness and bounded diagnostics

findings.bluetooth: Direct parsing proves Apple arm64e bluetoothd platform=27 flags=0 CDHash 729fad33b073d2f2df623d3fec33472e8d070d79, while review10 carries platform=0 flags=2 CDHash 0a15e3a72da18bc7b2443a7e676e30a72a09d028 in a v2 02/00/00/00 entry. The device runtime now changes platform before CDHash collection, verifies every code page hash, and changes exactly that generated v2 entry to category 1. Kernelcache disassembly proves AMFI call 102 copies 0x40 bytes and uses the error pointer/size at 0x30/0x38 with a 0x404 output.
findings.usb: The initial review11 ENBLSLPM and USB3 SUSPHY settings are reverted. Core role switching no longer asserts PHY soft reset or reruns phyInit without the GCC QUSB2PHY BCR. Host restoration clears all three sleep bits and applies Samsung GUCTL bit17, GUCTL1 bits21/8 and GUCTL2 bit16. UFS log sync is restricted to background first HSE/HCE/U3 polling. AppleUSBHostPort receives debug mask 0x40000019 once per registered port.
findings.wifi: Pinned ath11k pcic.c directly masked the shared single MSI from CE and ext interrupt paths despite guarded helpers. All CE/ext tasklet, handler, NAPI and shutdown paths now use the guarded helpers. WCN6855 hw2.1 parameters, QMI host-cap/wlan_cfg/mem segments, ASPM disable and existing idle_ps override match the pinned source; no speculative power change was made. Fatal and timeout diagnostics include MHI/BHI, WMI/HTT16, CE2/CE3 software and hardware/shadow indices and strict IRQ depth, plus a 64-entry startup TX/RX trace budget.
